reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #1716 titled '[每日信息流] 2025-05-20' is an auto-generated daily news-feed artifact, not a request for a code change. Evidence: (1) The issue carries only the label 'daily'; its body is a curated list of external security-news article links (The DFIR Report, 奇安信攻防社区, 安全客, Security Boulevard, etc.) with no defect, feature spec, reproduction, file/component target, or code request. (2) The repository README and .github/workflows/daily.yml document this: the workflow runs 'gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] $(date)" -F today.md --label "daily"' — every such issue is bot-generated content, not an engineering task. (3) Git history of the default branch is exclusively these auto-commits ('每日安全资讯(YYYY-MM-DD)', '每日精选汇总(YYYY-MM-DD)'), confirming the daily issues are data output of the crawler, not engineering issues. (4) The admission.technical_signals (bug/bug_bounty/bypass/error/failures/overflow) and component_references (ELPACO/ESP32) are keyword artifacts harvested from article titles/URLs inside the news feed, e.g. 'Another Confluence Bites the Dust: Falling to ELPACO-team Ransomware' and infosecwriteups.com 'bug_bounty' tags — they are not engineering evidence about this repository. (5) The admission.funding of $20,000 USD is unverifiable: the issue body, title and its 0 comments contain no funding/grant/bounty amount, and a repo-wide search for '20000'/'funding'/'bounty' matches only external article titles in archived feeds. There is no live funding tied to a code deliverable, and no competing open PR references this issue (search of open PRs for '1716' returns 0; only unrelated open PRs #2617 and #2335 exist). This is a documentation/content deliverable of the product (the daily feed) rather than a reproducible defect or focused engineering feature. No checkout changes were made.
